Why haven't any terrorist groups claimed responsibility for the TWA
and Olympic Park bombings?  I mean, what's the point of risking your
life and freedom to blow up lots of people if you aren't going to
make some kind of demand or political statement?

At least the Unabomber blew people up for a reason and took credit
for it.
